capabilities.rationale: Allow the desktop host to perform explicitly requested workflows in protected owner locations; this does not grant root, Keychain, screen, or UI control.
capabilities.future_probe: Create a non-sensitive prepared file in each declared protected test location, stat it, and delete only that prepared file.
capabilities.restart: Restart ChatGPT/Codex once after all macOS privacy changes.
capabilities.revoke: Turn off only the attested identity in Full Disk Access, restart it, and rerun the prepared-file probe expecting denial.
capabilities.reattestation: Any bundle ID, Team ID, designated requirement, canonical path, or major-version change.

capabilities.rationale: Computer Use needs Accessibility to inspect UI structure and click, type, and navigate.
capabilities.future_probe: Read a harmless test app accessibility tree, click one test control, and type a fixed non-secret string.
capabilities.restart: Restart the Computer Use component through its supported product lifecycle after all privacy changes.
capabilities.revoke: Turn off Codex Computer Use in Accessibility and rerun the test-app probe expecting denial.
capabilities.reattestation: Any responsible identity or attribution change, or a failed prompt-free repetition.

capabilities.rationale: Computer Use needs Screen Recording to observe target application pixels.
capabilities.future_probe: Capture only a prepared non-sensitive test window and verify a redacted boolean result.
capabilities.restart: Restart the Computer Use component once after all privacy changes.
capabilities.revoke: Turn off Codex Computer Use in Screen & System Audio Recording and rerun the test-window probe expecting denial.
capabilities.reattestation: Any responsible identity or attribution change, macOS major update, or failed repetition.

capabilities.rationale: Input Monitoring is unnecessary for baseline Computer Use unless a measured passive global-input requirement remains after Accessibility works.
capabilities.future_probe: Only after a documented feature failure, test the smallest passive-input behavior without recording input content.
capabilities.restart: Only if the future measured requirement needs it.
capabilities.revoke: Turn off the exact identity in Input Monitoring and confirm baseline Computer Use still passes.
capabilities.reattestation: Any proposal to add this capability requires new evidence and owner authority.

capabilities.rationale: Files & Folders, Removable Volumes, Local Network, App Management, and Automation are granted only for a named workflow and actual responsible identity or sender-receiver pair.
capabilities.future_probe: Use prepared files, a disposable signed test app, a local test endpoint, or one harmless named Automation receiver query.
capabilities.restart: Only where the product or macOS requires it.
capabilities.revoke: Remove the exact category or sender-receiver approval and rerun only its bounded negative probe.
capabilities.reattestation: New workflow, receiver, responsible identity, or lifecycle owner.

capabilities.rationale: macOS TCC does not authorize target apps inside the Computer Use product policy.
capabilities.future_probe: Use one prepared test app twice; the second run must be prompt-free and must not target Terminal or ChatGPT.
capabilities.restart: Start a new task after policy changes; restart only if current product guidance requires it.
capabilities.revoke: Remove the exact app from Always-allowed apps and confirm the next attempt asks or denies.
capabilities.reattestation: Allowlist change, Computer Use update, or unexpected prompt.

capabilities.rationale: Chrome extension connection, per-domain access, and browser-history access are separate from macOS TCC and from each other.
capabilities.future_probe: Verify Connected in the selected profile, use one reviewed public test host twice, and do not request browser history.
capabilities.restart: Start a new task; restart Chrome and ChatGPT only if connection remains unavailable.
capabilities.revoke: Remove the host from the allowlist or disable the extension; keep profile, sessions, and history intact.
capabilities.reattestation: Extension ID or publisher change, profile change, domain-policy change, or disconnected state.

capabilities.rationale: The signed Google updater is the observed Chrome lifecycle component; ownership or channel must not change during Phase 3 preparation.
capabilities.future_probe: Read-only vendor update health and version check without triggering an update.
capabilities.revoke: Future Chrome adoption plan must use the vendor-supported lifecycle and preserve the browser profile.
capabilities.reattestation: Updater identity, label, channel, or Chrome owner decision changes.

capabilities.rationale: Locked Use is a narrow future unattended-GUI capability and requires an Apple authorization plug-in plus an active trusted Computer Use turn.
capabilities.future_probe: After vendor-supported reconciliation and owner approval, verify one active trusted turn temporarily unlocks, covers all displays, and relocks on local input.
capabilities.restart: Follow the vendor flow only after the installed and embedded identities are re-attested.
capabilities.revoke: Disable Locked Use in product settings and use the vendor-supported authorization plug-in removal path; verify ordinary screen lock remains.
capabilities.reattestation: Installed and embedded versions differ now; reconcile through the vendor flow before any test, and repeat after every plug-in identity or version change.

capabilities.rationale: Developer Tools privacy approval and DevToolsSecurity policy are distinct from TCC file and UI grants and from root authority.
capabilities.future_probe: Build and run a harmless local test program and perform an Apple-signed debugger probe twice without an authorization prompt.
capabilities.restart: Restart the developer host only if macOS requests it.
capabilities.revoke: Disable the exact Developer Tools app entry and restore DevToolsSecurity through an owner-authenticated maintenance action, then confirm the debugger probe no longer silently succeeds.
capabilities.reattestation: Developer host identity, selected developer directory, or macOS major version changes.

capabilities.rationale: Happ and AmneziaVPN are installed VPN adoption candidates; Happ is attested, while Amnezia remains blocked by strict signature and Gatekeeper health without inspecting profiles, credentials, or network state.
capabilities.future_probe: A separately authorized Phase 7 adoption must identify the current owner and supported lifecycle, preserve a fallback network path, and test connection and rollback without retaining profiles or credentials.
capabilities.revoke: Future removal or extension revocation must follow the separately reviewed vendor lifecycle and preserve network recovery.
capabilities.reattestation: Any app, extension, Team, designated requirement, version, receipt, signature, Gatekeeper, owner, channel, or network-extension change.

capabilities.rationale: Root/admin authority is independent of TCC and is intentionally outside Phase 3 preparation.
capabilities.future_probe: Phase 4 must deny unknown input, validate fixed executables, pass a non-interactive status probe, and prove audit and rollback.
capabilities.revoke: Use the future emergency disable path from the Phase 4 contract.
capabilities.reattestation: Every broker binary, policy, sudoers, or control-commit change.
